title: Choose the Match visual world
question: More Greek-god. The roll assigned Kylix Tondo Arena. Keep it, take an alternate, re-roll, or take the category standard. A third re-roll will ask what quality is still missing.

options.label: Kylix Tondo Arena
options.lineage: Attic red-figure drinking cups with circular interior scenes
options.thesis: Match is the god-painted tondo; the run shell is the cup rim; Draft walks the exterior frieze of Olympians.
options.viewport: Desktop: cup rim and handles as run chrome; circular Match stage center; Hermes–Zeus frieze as offer banks; dual seats as opposed figures in the tondo; Life as painted bands on the rim.
options.risk: Museum-poster calm if fight fires stay static brush marks instead of living figure action.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.lineage: Theater cycloramas that pass from night through cobalt and rose into day
options.thesis: Gods arrive as light: Match phases are night, first light, dawn, day behind a contained agon stage.
options.viewport: Run shell as black house; Match as actors on a banded horizon; Draft as cue racks; fight climax washes the cyc to day.
options.risk: Olympian identity can blur into generic stage lighting without cult statues or god cues.
options.case: Wins divine theatrical presence; weaker specific Olympian iconography than the kylix.

options.label: Mecha Crisis Wall
options.lineage: Nineties mecha-anime command walls with phosphor type and hazard bands
options.thesis: Each God is a crisis schematic; Draft arms the wall; the fight is the countdown and condition bars.
options.viewport: Run shell as black command frame; Match schematic center; god labels as bilingual blocks; Life as monumental digits.
options.risk: Reads anime ops before Olympus unless god silhouettes own the center.
options.case: Wins fight urgency and spectacle; Greek gods are bolted on, not native.

options.label: Signal Oscilloscope
options.lineage: CRT oscilloscope benches with phosphor traces on etched graticules
options.thesis: Boon fires are triggered traces; Gods are channels; Draft arms probes before the sweep locks.
options.viewport: Run shell as instrument bezel; Match as dual-channel Life traces; offers as channel arming; cooldown as timebase.
options.risk: Almost no mythic identity without inventing god channel art outside the grammar.
options.case: Wins cooldown/fire clarity; fuses poorly with Greek-god presence.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Dark auto-battler HUD with a light Greek skin on card art, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Familiar TFT chrome; gods appear mainly as card illustrations and names.
canonCard.risk: Expected; Olympus stays decoration, not the system.
